description: Build an ordered self-guided walking route in one city that fits a time budget, e.g. "a two-hour historical walk in Rome". Picks sights by interests, periods and style, orders them to keep walking short, and returns each stop with walking minutes, suggested time on site, clock times and a Google Maps walking link.

city_id.description: Gingerguide city id, e.g. "rome" or "istanbul" (from search_cities).

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.

must_include.description: Sight ids that must be on the route.

pace.description: Walking pace: relaxed (3.5 km/h), normal (4.5 km/h) or brisk (5.5 km/h).

periods.description: Historical periods to favour, e.g. ["byzantine"] or ["roman","renaissance"].

start_attraction_id.description: Start at this sight instead of a coordinate.

style.description: must_see favours each city's headline sights, hidden_gems favours lesser-known ones, balanced mixes both.

weekday.description: Day of the week of the visit. Sights known to be closed that day are left out (closing days are researched for some cities only).

name: plan_walking_tour
title: Plan walking tour
